Chapter 464: Chapter 9 All are Provisions (Please Subscribe)_2

“Continue to explore the true limit of the power of Taiji.”

Lin Yuan struck out recklessly, and the terrifying wave of force began to shake the entire Fourth Heaven and even affected the Third and Second Heavens below.

…

Nine Heavens.

Second Layer of Heaven.

A Peak Dao Integration True Immortal was leisurely roaming this layer of heaven with a descendant he cherished.

...

The Nine Divine Heavens of the Spirit Realm are extremely special, often visited by True Immortal-level powerhouses. Occasionally, they bring their progeny, for beings below True Immortals, experiencing the mysteries of the Nine Heavens is a great opportunity and fortune.

“In the Second Layer of Heaven, some ‘spectacles’ and ‘phenomena’ often appear. Tomorrow, observe carefully and commit it to memory; this will be greatly beneficial for your future cultivation path,” said the Peak Dao Integration True Immortal, a white-browed elder, chuckling as he stroked his beard.

“Understood, Ancestor,” replied a young disciple, swallowing nervously as he tried to look around and memorize everything he saw.

After a while,

“Ancestor, this Nine Heavens is really huge, isn’t it?” the disciple couldn’t help but exclaim.

“The Nine Divine Heavens of the Spirit Realm are vast and boundless. This is just the Second Heaven; above are the Third and Fourth Heavens…” the Peak Dao Integration True Immortal patiently explained.

“However, only those at the Half-Step Tribulation stage can attempt to climb to the Third Heaven, and as for the Fourth Heaven, it is the realm of Tribulation-Transcending Celestial Kings…”

The white-browed elder sighed. Although he was at the peak of Dao Integration, the Tribulation stage was still far beyond his reach.

The mental tribulation and Bodily Tribulation were two significant barriers that obstructed countless True Immortals.

The white-browed elder was lost in thought for a moment and was about to speak again when his expression suddenly changed.

“What is that?”

The white-browed elder looked up; it was the area of the Third Layer of Heaven. At that moment, a terrifying fluctuation was traveling from the Third Heaven to the Second Heaven.

Like the drums of the divine, mighty and powerful, the clouds of the Second Heaven dispersed and the space constantly rippled.

“This?”

The white-browed elder’s face showed shock. In the Nine Heavens, even a True Immortal peak powerhouse like himself could at best affect an area of ten thousand miles, but now? Merely the aftershock of a force was penetrating down to the Second Heaven?

“Ancestor…is there a Half-Step Immortal King making a move in the Third Heaven?” The disciple by his side trembled, and if not for the protection of the white-browed elder, he would probably have been scared into sitting on the ground.

The aftershock of a higher layer’s power swept down like divine might.

“It’s not the Third Heaven, it’s a higher layer than the Third Heaven!”

The white-browed elder carefully sensed for a while, his face slightly pale.

As a Peak True Immortal, although he couldn’t climb to the Third Heaven, he could still judge the source of the aftershocks.

“A higher layer than the Third Heaven?”

The young disciple was confused for a moment, that must mean…

“An Immortal King, at least a Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King is making a move.”

The white-browed elder spoke with difficulty, and in his heart, he had another speculation—transmitting aftershocks to another layer was not something an ordinary Immortal King could do.

It might even be the famed Supreme Immortal King!

“In my lifetime, to see a Supreme Immortal King making a move?”

The white-browed elder was emotionally stirred; as a Peak True Immortal who had traveled three thousand Daos for many ages, he had a chance to witness a Tribulation-Transcending Celestial King.

But a Supreme Immortal King? That was the transcendent among Celestial Kings; most True Immortals never saw one in their lifetime.

…

Xuanwang Domain.

Daode Immortal Sect.

“Li Zu sent me a message?” a no-nonsense-looking woman said, her face changing slightly as she looked towards her two peers.

“Li Zu?”

“Li Zu’s personality means he wouldn’t contact us without something important,” she said.

“Quickly check, could it be something unexpected has happened with the war against Huailong Palace?”

The two peers realized the gravity of the situation.

The three of them were the most outstanding descendants of ‘Jun Xiaoyao’.

They were Jun Haiqiu, Jun Nangong, and Jun Yunxun.

In the Spirit Realm’s Daode Immortal Sect, the Mu Family was a relatively strong lineage, but the Jun Family… at least until people like Jun Dongjin ascended, there was no Jun Family.

After hundreds of thousands of years, with the efforts of the Jun Family lineage and the support of Li Qing, the Jun Family managed to establish itself in the Immortal Sect.

“I’ll check now.”

Jun Haiqiu immediately opened the message from Li Qing.

He quickly skimmed through it.

“Li Zu says…” Jun Haiqiu paused, somewhat unsure how to proceed.

“You all take a look.”

Jun Haiqiu expanded the message.

Jun Nangong and Jun Yunxun quickly read through it.

“An ancestor from our Jun Family has returned?”

“This ancestor, the youngest son of the founder of the East Jin, and the founder of the Martial Tao Cultivation System?”

The three of them from Jun Haiqiu’s group were stunned.

From a young age, they had heard numerous rumors about this ‘Wuji’ ancestor.

It was said that this ‘Wuji’ ancestor had exceptional talent and had even negotiated with the Cangqing Immortal. Today, the position of the Jun Family in the Immortal Sect was mainly due to the efforts of this Wuji Ancestor.

Without the Wuji Ancestor, the Jun Family would not be where it was today; they might not even have ascended from the Lower Realms in the first place.

“Wuji Ancestor, he has returned?”

Jun Nangong’s expression was somewhat excited; it had been tens of thousands of years, and the ancestors of the Jun Family had never given up searching for Wuji Ancestor.

Even the Daode Immortal Sect was searching, but there had never been any news.

Many elders of the Jun Family even thought that Wuji Ancestor might have died long ago, otherwise, how could there have been no sign of him for so many years?

“Let’s go.”

“We will meet Wuji Ancestor now.”

“The longing of my father, my mother, my grandfather, my great grandfather, the desire of our Jun Family’s ancestors, has actually been realized in our generation.”

Jun Yunxun was equally stirred. Li Qing’s search for Wuji Ancestor was a search for his own mentor; the Cangqing Immortal’s search for Wuji Ancestor also had other purposes.

Only their Jun Family sought Wuji Ancestor from the bottom of their hearts. Since the progenitor Jun Dongjin, they always treated searching for Wuji Ancestor as the ultimate goal.

…

“The Martial Temple is starting to accept disciples on a large scale?”

“Anyone from the Human Race can be admitted to the Martial Temple?”

“Upon entering the Martial Temple, one can receive the teachings of the Martial Tao Cultivation System? Even those on the Immortal Path can be admitted to the Martial Temple?”

Within Xianyao City, a message spread like a hurricane; previously, the Martial Temple had been very strict about accepting disciples, but now, they had relaxed this restriction.

“Hurry, hurry, hurry.”

“There are free Martial Tao teachings being given away.”

“It’s said that the Seventh Stage Martial Tao is not inferior to a True Immortal of the Merged Path; the Martial Tao Cultivation System must have exceptional aspects.”

Figures quickly lined up outside the Martial Temple, whispering amongst themselves.

“Why is the Martial Temple doing this?”

“Did the three ancestors of the Martial Temple return recently? Could this be their idea?”

“I don’t think so. Over such a long period, even when the three ancestors were present, the rules of the Martial Temple hardly changed. Now this sudden relaxation must be due to something unknown happening…”

“Who cares, as long as there are Martial Tao teachings being given out, I have nothing to lose.”

…

Martial Temple Hall.

Lin Yuan sat in the main seat, his gaze sweeping across and taking in all of Xianyao City.

“Master, is it really okay to release the Martial Tao teachings so freely…” Li Qing stood respectfully on one side, cautiously inquiring.

“It’s fine.”

Lin Yuan said nonchalantly.

He wanted to spread the Martial Arts Evolution System thoroughly in this realm. Relying solely on the small area of the Martial Temple, it would be impossible even with a million years.

Therefore, Lin Yuan decided to release the Martial Tao teachings.

Of course, these released teachings from the Martial Temple had been modified by Lin Yuan to enhance one’s strength in a short amount of time.

For the lower-level cultivators, whether it’s the Immortal Path or Martial Tao, or even other cultivation systems,

the most crucial aspect is short-term effectiveness. Even for the Great Dao, if one cannot get started and it does not bring any improvement, then it is meaningless.

As for releasing the Martial Tao teachings widely, which might lead to a mix of good and bad cultivators and even result in little loyalty to the Martial Temple,

Lin Yuan did not care.

In the Myriad Realms of the Heavens, as long as one entered his Martial Tao, no matter the thought process, all would be fodder for the future ‘Ultimate Leap.’
